defects.description: Tokens absent from `markets` are skipped by stress_loss and by resolution's exposure() (disclosed in a ponytail comment and in open_issues). Phase 1 marketdata._set_markets deletes markets 6 h after end_ms (trader/marketdata.py:406-407). Once wired with ctx.markets, a held printed-but-disputed market older than 6 h therefore drops out of the 20% resolution total. Standalone resolution_check also approves an intent whose printed cid is missing from `markets` (probe 4: approved, room 10.00); check_live rejects it first with 'unknown market'.
defects.fix_hint: Fail closed: in stress_loss and resolution, count shares in tokens not found in `markets` as shares x 1.0. In _resolution, reject when intent.cid is printed but missing from markets. Alternatively, have the wiring package pass held markets until they are redeemed.

defects.description: Invalid sigma or spot values are not treated as unpriceable. A negative DVOL gives sigma<0 and an inverted digital: a long-YES BTC book shows a stress gain of -0.90 instead of a loss of +4.97 (probe 2). An infinite spot gives loss 0.0. Only None, 0 and NaN fail closed. Deribit never publishes a negative DVOL, and Phase 1 fetch_dvol does not validate it.
defects.fix_hint: In _yes, return None unless `S > 0 and math.isfinite(S) and sigma > 0 and math.isfinite(sigma)`. This makes the position a total loss.

defects.description: The SevenDayDrawdown constructor pushes saved samples without the finite check that on_equity applies. A NaN or inf sample in a corrupted persisted file becomes the window max, and the breaker cannot trip until it expires up to 7 days later (probe 3: NaN restored, then 100 -> 50 gives 0 trips). samples() itself never emits non-finite values.
defects.fix_hint: In __init__, skip samples where `not math.isfinite(float(eq))`, the same rule as on_equity.

defects.description: The test file imports clearance_key and key_id from trader.kernel. These names are not on the dispatch's list of stable Phase 1 imports. This affects tests only and has no production effect.
defects.fix_hint: Accept as a test-only dependency, or build the clearance key inline. The rule applies to production code first.
